title: MxAgile Test Contract
description: Canonical proof obligation for a set of requirements. Captures WHAT must be proven — layer-agnostic, not a test implementation. Derived from requirement acceptance criteria and optionally from a Mocketeer Design Contract. Canonical location: planning/test-contracts/TC-NNN.yaml. See policies/test-contract-derivation.md.

ID.description: Stable identifier. Must match filename stem: TC-001.yaml -> ID: TC-001.

status.description: draft: being authored. active: approved proof obligation. stale: upstream requirement/AC changed — must be updated before use. impacted: upstream design contract changed — review required. superseded: replaced by another contract.

staleness_cause.description: Populated when status is stale, impacted, or superseded. Null when active/draft.

requirement_ids.description: REQ-NNN identifiers this contract covers. At least one required.

acceptance_criteria_ids.description: AC-NNN identifiers from the referenced requirements that this contract proves.

design_contract_ref.description: Optional upstream Mocketeer Design Contract reference: <mockup_id>@revision=<N>. Populated when this contract was derived from a Mocketeer output. Null for requirement-only derivation.

proof_points.description: Discrete proof obligations. Each is a testable claim with a specific role, data state, and required evidence layers.

out_of_scope.description: What this contract explicitly does not cover.

derived_at.description: ISO date when this contract was first produced.

derived_by.description: Agent or skill that produced this contract.

proof_point.description: A single testable claim: who, what data state, what is asserted, which evidence layers are mandatory.

id.description: Stable ID. Must be unique within this contract.

claim.description: Observable outcome assertion. Written as the system property that must hold — not as a test step. Example: 'A ROLE-MANAGER user can submit the create-site form and the record persists.'

role.description: Role under test. Prefix with '!' for negative authorization proof (role must NOT have access). Example: 'ROLE-MANAGER' or '!ROLE-VIEWER'.

operation.description: Optional. The specific operation being tested on the resource. Standard values: READ, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, EXECUTE. Domain-specific values allowed. When absent, the proof point tests the capability holistically. INFERENCE PROHIBITION: CANNOT UPDATE does not imply CANNOT READ; CAN READ does not imply CAN UPDATE. Each operation must be independently derived.

authorization_disposition.description: Authorization disposition for this role+operation combination. REQUIRED: role must have this permission. EXPLICITLY_FORBIDDEN: role must NOT (canonical source is explicit). UNSPECIFIED: no canonical source addresses this. UNKNOWN: contradicting signals. Drives autonomous remediation classification when set.

data_state.description: Required application data state for this proof point.

required_layers.description: Evidence layers that MUST pass. All must be satisfied for this proof point to be accepted. See policies/verification-layers.md.

optional_layers.description: Evidence layers that add confidence but are not blocking for acceptance.

security_dimensions.description: Security dimensions exercised by this proof point. Empty array for non-security proof points. See policies/verification-layers.md for dimension semantics.

acceptance_clause_id.description: AC-NNN identifier from the parent requirement.

design_contract_elements.description: IDs from the upstream Mocketeer Design Contract (REQ-NNN, DEC-NNN, PERM-NNN, ROLE-NNN) that this proof point originates from.

status.description: Per-proof-point status override. When absent, inherits parent contract status.

remediation_state.description: Autonomous remediation classification. Null when not applicable. See policies/autonomous-remediation.md.
